notes: Prompt step 5.5: an account-deletion or data-rights request is escalated in every phase, whatever intent and confidence the classifier assigns (only a high-confidence spam verdict, which step 5 handles first, would be wrong here), so intent_any_of lists the plausible classifications and the outcome fields are what matter. The sender asks for a confirmation reply; the agent must still send nothing, because a person first verifies the request with the account's own email address and then deletes by hand (docs/features/auth.md, 'Account deletion').
